description: The page the app loads is served by the Basics server on the loopback interface, so it is a remote origin to Tauri and needs its own capability. It gets exactly the window commands a title bar needs: start dragging, minimize, toggle maximize, close (which hides to the tray) and the maximize state plus resize events to pick the right icon. No shell, filesystem or opener permission is granted, so even a compromised localhost page cannot run processes, read files or open URLs through the app.
